rationale: C08 plausibly supplied the child’s distinctive retained-use carveout. Both directives transfer or restore land while reserving a narrowly defined federal installation and an express right of access. That machinery is more specific than the routine Hawaii land-restoration formula shared with C03 and C23. C03 is the strongest alternative for the child’s general restoration language, especially “possession, use, and control,” but it lacks the material reservation-and-access feature.
